props.name: src
props.description: URL, bytes, File/Blob, `{url, httpHeaders}` or a pdf.js document. Reactive.

props.name: password
props.description: Password to try first.

props.name: documentOptions
props.description: Extra pdf.js `getDocument()` options.

props.name: document
props.description: The loaded document state (bind:document to read it outside).

props.name: zoom
props.description: 1 = 100%. Bindable.

props.name: zoomMode
props.description: 'auto' | 'page-width' | 'page-height' | 'page-fit' | 'manual'. Bindable.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page (1-based). Bindable; setting it scrolls.

props.name: columns
props.description: Pages per row: 1–4 or 'auto' (more pages per row as you zoom out). Bindable.

props.name: maxColumns
props.description: Upper bound for 'auto' columns. Default 4.

props.name: firstPageAlone
props.description: Book layout: first page alone (cover), then spreads.

props.name: smoothZoom
props.description: Ease zoom changes (wheel, buttons, fit modes, zoomTo). Default true.

props.name: oversampling
props.description: Render zoomed-out pages at up to 2× so quick zoom-ins stay sharp. Default true.

props.name: detailMinWidth
props.description: Pages narrower than this (CSS px) skip text layers / text indexing. Default 260.

props.name: focusDuration
props.description: Focus highlight duration in ms. Default 1800.

props.name: focusPadding
props.description: Padding (PDF points) around focused rects. Default 6.

props.name: messages
props.description: UI strings (e.g. a translation); merged over setMessages() and the English defaults.

props.name: keymap
props.description: Keyboard shortcuts (merged over `defaultKeymap`); annotations use them too.

props.name: pageTheme
props.description: Page content theme: 'none' | 'invert' | 'dim' | 'sepia' | 'recolor' or a strategy.

props.name: theme
props.description: UI theme hint exposed as data-theme.

props.name: pageFrame
props.description:
Page edge style (exposed as data-page-frame, styled by styles.css):
'shadow' (default), 'border', 'rounded', 'flat' (no edge) or 'none' (no frame, no background).

props.name: overscan
props.description: Render pages within N viewport-lengths. Default 1.

props.name: viewer
props.description: The viewer state (bind:viewer to call commands from outside).

props.name: external
props.description: How external URLs open. Default 'new-tab'.

props.name: onLinkClick
props.description: Replace the click action (e.g. open a cited paper in your app). Return false to skip the default.

props.name: width
props.description: Preview width in CSS px. Default 420.

props.name: kinds
props.description: Only preview these link kinds.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep rendering `child` while closed (with `open: false`) for exit transitions.

props.name: modes
props.description: Fit modes offered, in order.

props.name: labels
props.description: Labels for fit modes.

props.name: query
props.description: Search query. Bindable.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Debounce in ms. Default 150.

props.name: find
props.description: The find state (bind:find to drive it from outside).

props.name: caseSensitive
props.description: Match case exactly.

props.name: diacritics
props.description: Match accents exactly (é ≠ e).

props.name: wholeWord
props.description: Only whole words.

props.name: regex
props.description: Treat the query as a regular expression (applied to normalised text).

props.name: captureShortcut
props.description: Focus this input on Ctrl/⌘ + F while the pointer or focus is in the viewer. Default true.

props.name: show
props.description: Which matches to draw: every match, only the current one, or none (list-only UIs). Default 'all'.

props.name: match
props.type: Snippet<[{ match: FindMatch; current: boolean; points: string[] }]>
props.description: Custom SVG for a match (inside a viewBox in page points): one `points` string per quad.

props.name: item
props.description: Custom row content.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when the PDF has no outline.

snippetProps.name: containsActive
snippetProps.description: The active item is inside this one.

props.name: width
props.description: Thumbnail width in CSS px. Default 120.

props.name: followCurrent
props.description: Keep the current page's thumbnail scrolled into view. Default true.

snippetProps.name: canvasProps
snippetProps.description: Only given to `child`: spread it on your canvas host.

props.name: annotations
props.description: The annotations. Bindable (or pass a value + onAnnotationsChange).

props.name: onAnnotationsChange
props.description: After each change (one call per undo step): persist here.

props.name: tool
props.description: Active tool. Bindable.

props.name: color
props.description: Active palette key. Bindable.

props.name: palette
props.description: Palette (bindable): custom colours picked by users are appended to it.

props.name: annotationsVisible
props.description: Show annotations (also `store.annotationsVisible`).

props.name: notesVisible
props.description: Show side notes and gutter markers (also `store.notesVisible`).

props.name: colorFilter
props.description: Only show these palette keys (null = all; also `store.colorFilter`).

props.name: foreign
props.description: Annotations that came from the PDF: 'editable' | 'readonly' | 'hidden'.

props.name: stickyTools
props.description: Keep the tool after creating (highlighter sessions). Default false: back to select (Shift keeps it once).

props.name: selectOn
props.description: How existing annotations are picked for editing. Default 'dblclick'.

props.name: editOnCreate
props.description: Open the note of a new annotation for typing (Enter keeps, Esc discards). Default true.

props.name: keymap
props.description: Keyboard shortcuts, merged over `defaultKeymap`.

props.name: importFromPdf
props.description: Load the annotations stored in the PDF (ours losslessly, others per `foreign`).

props.name: reanchor
props.description: Re-anchor highlights to their quoted text when a document loads (e.g. a newer version of the paper).

props.name: store
props.description: The store (bind:store to use it outside).

props.name: noteIcon
props.description: Custom note icon.

props.name: areaLabel
props.description: Custom label chip for area boxes.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep rendering `child` while closed (with `open: false`) so you can run exit transitions.

props.description: Keep rendering `child` while closed (with `open: false`) so you can run exit transitions.

props.name: showQuote
props.description: Repeat the quoted text inside the popover. Default false (it is right there on the page).

snippetProps.name: color
snippetProps.description: CSS colour for the current page theme.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep rendering `child` while closed (with `open: false`) so you can run exit transitions.

snippetProps.name: color
snippetProps.description: CSS colour for the current page theme.

props.name: filter
props.description: Which annotations get a side note. Default: those with a comment or a label.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between notes (px). Default 8.

props.name: minWidth
props.description:
Notes never overflow the view: they shrink to the room beside the page
(`viewer.sideRoom`), and below this width (px) turn into compact markers
that show the note on hover and open it on click. Default 160.

props.name: layout
props.description: Force a layout instead of adapting to the room. Default 'auto'.

props.name: markers
props.description: 'notes' (default): annotations with a note or label; 'all': every annotation.

props.name: filter
props.description: Custom filter (overrides `markers`).

props.name: mode
props.description: 'auto' (default): textarea while editing, rendered Markdown + maths otherwise.

props.name: provider
props.description: Reference metadata provider (e.g. `defaultCitationProvider()`); optional.

props.name: auto
props.description: Analyse automatically on load. Default true.

props.name: onCitationClick
props.type: ( citation: InTextCitation, references: Reference[], event: MouseEvent ) => void | false
props.description: Replace the click action on an in-text citation. Return false to skip the default jump.

props.name: onCrossRefClick
props.description: Replace the click action on "Fig. 3" / "Section 2" links. Return false to skip the default jump.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep rendering the `child` snippet while closed (with `open: false`) so you can run exit transitions.

props.name: layout
props.description: Groups like [1,2,3]: 'list' shows all, 'pager' one at a time, 'auto' lists up to 4. Default 'auto'.

props.name: onReferenceClick
props.type: ( reference: Reference, citation: InTextCitation, event?: Event ) => void | false
props.description: Replace the default "go to reference" (e.g. open or import the cited paper). Return false to skip the default.

props.name: reference
props.type: Snippet< [ { reference: Reference; metadata: MetadataState | undefined; go: (e?: Event) => void; compact: boolean; } ] >
props.description: Custom rendering of each reference (default card parts otherwise).

props.name: actions
props.type: Snippet<[{ reference: Reference; metadata: MetadataState | undefined }]>
props.description: Extra actions in each reference's footer (Save, Import, Open…).

snippetProps.name: index
snippetProps.description: Index of the reference shown in 'pager' layout.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep rendering the `child` snippet while closed (with `open: false`) so you can run exit transitions.

props.name: idPrefix
props.description: Prefix for heading ids (id = prefix + section id). Default 'section-'.

props.name: baseLevel
props.description: Heading level used for top-level sections. Default 2.

props.name: visible
props.description: Show the headings (debug); hidden from view but not from assistive tech by default.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: Deepest level shown (1 = top-level only).

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown while analysing or when no sections were found.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: Deepest level shown (1 = top-level only).

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown while analysing or when no sections were found.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: Deepest level shown (1 = top-level only). Default 2.

props.name: width
props.description: Strip width in CSS px. Default 80.

props.name: mode
props.description: 'scroll' (code-editor style, default) or 'fit' (whole document shrunk to the strip).

props.name: variant
props.description:
Look of the strip:
- 'pages': bitmap previews (blocks when pages get too small to read),
- 'blocks': plain page blocks with numbers,
- 'text': structure drawn from the text index (lines, headings, figures),
- 'spine': coloured section bands with labels (needs Paper.Root),
- 'heatmap': no pages, only markers / Minimap.Heatmap.
Default 'pages'.

props.name: pages
props.description: Draw page boxes at all. Default true (false = markers-only scrollbar).

props.name: wheel
props.description: Wheel over the strip scrolls the document (default) or the strip itself.

props.name: minPreviewHeight
props.description: Below this page height (px) bitmap previews become blocks. Default 36.

props.name: find
props.description: Add find matches (needs Find.Root).

props.name: annotations
props.description: Add annotations (needs Annotations.Root).

props.name: sections
props.description: Add section headings (needs Paper.Root).

props.name: bin
props.description: Bin height in px. Default 6.

props.name: color
props.description: CSS colour of the hottest bin.

props.name: action
props.description: Keymap action to show (e.g. 'markup.highlight'). Reflects user overrides.

props.name: index
props.description: Which of the action's combos (default the first).

props.name: inputmode
props.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

props.name: is
props.description: Specify that a standard HTML element should behave like a defined custom built-in element

props.name: bind:innerHTML
props.description: Elements with the contenteditable attribute support `innerHTML`, `textContent` and `innerText` bindings.

props.name: bind:textContent
props.description: Elements with the contenteditable attribute support `innerHTML`, `textContent` and `innerText` bindings.

props.name: bind:innerText
props.description: Elements with the contenteditable attribute support `innerHTML`, `textContent` and `innerText` bindings.

props.name: aria-activedescendant
props.description: Identifies the currently active element when DOM focus is on a composite widget, textbox, group, or application.

props.name: aria-atomic
props.description: Indicates whether assistive technologies will present all, or only parts of, the changed region based on the change notifications defined by the aria-relevant attribute.

props.name: aria-autocomplete
props.description:
Indicates whether inputting text could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's intended value for an input and specifies how predictions would be
presented if they are made.

props.name: aria-busy
props.description: Indicates an element is being modified and that assistive technologies MAY want to wait until the modifications are complete before exposing them to the user.

props.name: aria-checked
props.description: Indicates the current "checked" state of checkboxes, radio buttons, and other widgets.

props.name: aria-colcount
props.description: Defines the total number of columns in a table, grid, or treegrid.

props.name: aria-colindex
props.description: Defines an element's column index or position with respect to the total number of columns within a table, grid, or treegrid.

props.name: aria-colspan
props.description: Defines the number of columns spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

props.name: aria-controls
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current element.

props.name: aria-current
props.description: Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related elements.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: Identifies the element that provides a detailed, extended description for the object.

props.name: aria-disabled
props.description: Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise operable.

props.name: aria-dropeffect
props.description: Indicates what functions can be performed when a dragged object is released on the drop target.

props.name: aria-errormessage
props.description: Identifies the element that provides an error message for the object.

props.name: aria-expanded
props.description: Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded or collapsed.

props.name: aria-flowto
props.description:
Identifies the next element (or elements) in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion,
allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in document source order.

props.name: aria-grabbed
props.description: Indicates an element's "grabbed" state in a drag-and-drop operation.

props.name: aria-haspopup
props.description: Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that can be triggered by an element.

props.name: aria-hidden
props.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Indicates the entered value does not conform to the format expected by the application.

props.name: aria-keyshortcuts
props.description: Indicates keyboard shortcuts that an author has implemented to activate or give focus to an element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

props.name: aria-level
props.description: Defines the hierarchical level of an element within a structure.

props.name: aria-live
props.description: Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

props.name: aria-modal
props.description: Indicates whether an element is modal when displayed.

props.name: aria-multiline
props.description: Indicates whether a text box accepts multiple lines of input or only a single line.

props.name: aria-multiselectable
props.description: Indicates that the user may select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.

props.name: aria-orientation
props.description: Indicates whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous.

props.name: aria-owns
props.description:
Identifies an element (or elements) in order to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship
between DOM elements where the DOM hierarchy cannot be used to represent the relationship.

props.name: aria-placeholder
props.description:
Defines a short hint (a word or short phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value.
A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected format.

props.name: aria-posinset
props.description: Defines an element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

props.name: aria-pressed
props.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

props.name: aria-readonly
props.description: Indicates that the element is not editable, but is otherwise operable.

props.name: aria-relevant
props.type: | 'additions' | 'additions removals' | 'additions text' | 'all' | 'removals' | 'removals additions' | 'removals text' | 'text' | 'text additions' | 'text removals' | undefined | null
props.description: Indicates what notifications the user agent will trigger when the accessibility tree within a live region is modified.

props.name: aria-required
props.description: Indicates that user input is required on the element before a form may be submitted.

props.name: aria-roledescription
props.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized description for the role of an element.

props.name: aria-rowcount
props.description: Defines the total number of rows in a table, grid, or treegrid.

props.name: aria-rowindex
props.description: Defines an element's row index or position with respect to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid.

props.name: aria-rowspan
props.description: Defines the number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

props.name: aria-selected
props.description: Indicates the current "selected" state of various widgets.

props.name: aria-setsize
props.description: Defines the number of items in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

props.name: aria-sort
props.description: Indicates if items in a table or grid are sorted in ascending or descending order.

props.name: aria-valuemax
props.description: Defines the maximum allowed value for a range widget.

props.name: aria-valuemin
props.description: Defines the minimum allowed value for a range widget.

props.name: aria-valuenow
props.description: Defines the current value for a range widget.

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: Defines the human readable text alternative of aria-valuenow for a range widget.
